name: GST/HST Calculator
tagline: Work out GST, HST and provincial sales tax for a sale in any province.
audience: Canadian small businesses that charge sales tax
before: The rate depends on the province, and the provincial tax is easy to mix up with the HST. A wrong rate on an invoice is a mess to fix later.
after: Pick the province, enter the amount, and see the GST or HST, any provincial sales tax, and the total. The rates are the current general rates from the Canada Revenue Agency, with the source on the page.
privacy_note: The amount you type stays in your browser. Nothing is sent to us.
origin: Rates are the general rates on the Canada Revenue Agency GST/HST calculator page, in effect on or after 1 April 2025. Checked 12 November 2026.
built_with: One web page. No account and no server.
